<div class="case-study-section">

<div class="section-label">ABOUT THE PROJECT</div>

<h2 class="case-study-title">Sports stories don't stop on the field.</h2>

<p>
For this group project, we analyzed how athletes and their families are represented across online media and how those portrayals can shape the way audiences understand public figures.
</p>

<p>
Our research considered the relationship between sports, celebrity culture, family representation, and digital media.
</p>

<p>
The project required research, media analysis, collaboration, and presentation of our findings.
</p>
